name: avatar
title: Avatar
purpose: Represent a person or entity through a resilient image with an accessible text fallback.
avoidFor: Clickable controls without a link or button
Status without a visible status explanation
accessibility: The root exposes one image role and accessible label.
The source image is decorative inside the labelled root.
Fallback text remains visible when the source is missing, delayed, or fails.
commonMistakes: Making the avatar itself interactive instead of wrapping it in a semantic control.
Using a fallback that does not identify the represented entity.

examples.title: Initials fallback
examples.description: A deterministic text fallback keeps identity visible without an image source.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Avatar from "@/components/ui/Avatar.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Avatar label="Person placeholder" fallback="PP" size="lg" :fallback-delay="0" />
</template>

examples.title: Rounded entity
examples.description: Rounded geometry works for organization or workspace identity.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Avatar from "@/components/ui/Avatar.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Avatar label="Organization placeholder" fallback="OP" size="xl" shape="rounded" :fallback-delay="0" />
</template>

examples.title: Image error fallback
examples.description: A failed source returns immediately to the accessible fallback.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Avatar from "@/components/ui/Avatar.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Avatar src="/missing-avatar-placeholder.jpg" label="Person placeholder" fallback="PP" size="lg" :fallback-delay="0" />
</template>
